question: Which of the following articles of the Constitution of India states that no religious instruction shall be imparted in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 28**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 28** addresses the **issue of religious freedom** concerning attendance at **religious instruction or worship **within certain educational institutions.
 
• It stipulates:
 
 
• **Religious instruction** is prohibited in educational institutions that are entirely funded by the State.
 
• However, this prohibition does not extend to educational institutions administered by the State but established under a trust mandating religious instruction.
 
• Nevertheless, individuals attending such institutions cannot be forced to participate in religious instruction or attend religious worship.
 
• For minors, attending such activities requires the consent of their guardian.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 40 **of the Indian Constitution outlines one of the Directive Principles of State Policy, which mandates that the State must take measures to organize village panchayats.
 
• **Article 68 **of the Constitution of India specifies that an election to fill a vacancy in the office of Vice-President must be concluded before the end of the term.
 
• **Article 54 **of the Constitution of India pertains to the election process for the President of India.
